description: Trigger: cli/ops.rs cmd_status takes a single pool parameter and uses it to query msgid_map. msgid_map lives in the core DB (core_pool), not the transit DB. Bad behavior: article count in 'stoa-transit status' always returns 0 or a database error because the transit DB has no msgid_map table. Operators see incorrect status output.
title: cmd_status queries msgid_map from transit pool instead of core pool
